title: Settings
languageDescription: Choose the interface language for this browser.
createBotDescription: Enter a name and username. The connection token will appear after creation.
platformInviteDescription: Choose a role, expiration and registration limit.
publicDescription: Any platform user can start a chat with this bot from the catalog.
byLinkDescription: Join by invitation link or directly by username.
inviteMemberDescription: Choose how to join and the member roles.
byUsernameDescription: Connect the bot to a platform user account.
notificationsHint: Get notified about bot replies when the chat is closed.
notificationsPerChatHint: Configure sound, permanent off and temporary mute for each chat in its header or profile.
notificationsServerUnavailable: Push notifications are not configured on the server. Contact the administrator.
notificationsBrowserUnavailable: This browser does not support push notifications.
notificationsWorkerUnavailable: Could not register the service worker for push notifications.
notificationsBlocked: Allow notifications for Appercot in your browser settings.
botLinkHint: Set the roles, expiration and member limit for this link.
noBotMembers: Nobody has joined this bot yet.
transferHint: Transferring ownership resets the bot token and invitation links.
rotateTokenDescription: The active connection will close. Connect the bot with the new token.
rotateTokenHint: The current token will stop working. The new token will be shown only once.
stopBotDescription: Close the SDK connection while preserving chats and history.
resumeBotDescription: Allow the bot to reconnect with its current token.
stopBotConfirmation: The bot will disconnect and cannot authenticate until you resume it.
resumeBotConfirmation: The bot will be able to reconnect with its current token.
deleteBotDescription: Permanently delete the bot, all its chats, messages and invitations.
deleteBotConfirmation: This cannot be undone. All members will lose access to their chats and history with this bot.
